title: TensorSpine fixture
description: The metadata of a fixture: a safetensors file whose `__metadata__` is this document, JSON-encoded value by value, and whose tensors are named by the key grammar of its kind. A **unit** fixture is produced by a contract version's witness (Specification §4.1, O1.3) on random parameters and inputs — the one-occurrence document it ran, its parameters, the inputs, states and outputs of each invocation — and is what a conformer of that contract version is checked against, at the tolerance stated for its compute dtype. An **integration** fixture is dumped from the delivery implementation of a whole model at the legal cuts of its document: the values crossing every layer cut, every state after the prefill, the logits and the greedy tokens. One format, read by every generator's harness: a fixture recorded once is run by all of them.

compute.description: The dtype the recorded tensors were computed in. Tensors are stored as f32 whatever the compute dtype, so a comparison never rounds twice.

tolerance.description: Per compute dtype of the implementation being checked: the tolerance its outputs and states must meet against the recorded tensors, element by element, `|a − b| ≤ atol + rtol·|b|` with `b` the recorded value. A dtype without an entry is not covered by the fixture.

versions.description: The libraries that produced the tensors. A drift beyond tolerance after an upgrade is a patch with re-recorded fixtures, never silent (§8.2).

id.description: `<name>@<version>/<case>`: the fixture's identity, as the witness's manifest lists it.

arguments.description: The occurrence's resolved arguments, declared defaults applied — D1's, for the one occurrence of `document`.

document.description: The one-occurrence model document the witness ran: the occurrence under its arguments, one public input per input port, one public output per output port, every slot bound. Its catalog base is relative to the fixture's own directory; a harness writes the document beside the fixture, or rewrites the base, and derives it with the language's tools.

invocations.description: One entry per invocation, in order: the elements each public input delivers, by input name; an input absent from an entry delivers nothing in that invocation (§7). The states carry over from one invocation to the next, positions continuing per stream.

seed.description: The seed of the random parameters and inputs, so that the witness regenerates the fixture and the regeneration check can refuse a silent change.

generator.description: The generator whose kernel is the witness (`reference`).

version.description: That generator's version when the fixture was produced (a commit).

kernel.description: The kernel's file, relative to the generator's directory.

unit.description: Tensor keys: `param/<identity>` for every D3 identity of `document` — the document locates each identity at that key, so the fixture is its own checkpoint; `in/<k>/<input>` for every input delivering in invocation `k` (from 0) and `out/<k>/<output>` for every output it produced; `positions/<k>/<stream>` the positions of each stream's elements in invocation `k`; `state/<k>/<identity>/<component>` every D4 state after invocation `k` — a growing state holds its written positions, a window its span in chronological order, zero-padded before the first write, a fixed state its whole payload.

document.description: The corpus document the fixture is for, by name (`llama3-8b`).

name.description: The artifact's directory name — never a path of the machine that made the fixture.

id.description: The published identifier of the artifact (a Hub repository).

index_sha256.description: The hash of the checkpoint's index file, for a sharded checkpoint.

header_sha256.description: The hash of the safetensors header, for a checkpoint that is one file without an index.

implementation.description: The delivery implementation the tensors were dumped from (`transformers`).

program.description: The program that dumped them, relative to the repository.

composition.description: The composition whose index range was shortened (`decoder`).

layers.description: The number of layers kept; the document is truncated to as many before it is compared.

tokens.description: The greedy tokens the delivery implementation produced after the prompt; empty for a document without a generative output.

hook_map.description: How the delivery implementation's names were mapped onto D1 values and D4 states: data, the only place they meet.

integration.description: Tensor keys: `value/<D1 value>` for the output of every layer (the values crossing D6's layer cuts) and every exposed output; `state/<D4 identity>/<component>` for every state after the prefill; `logits/last` and `logits/argmax` for a generative document.
